composition_boundary.full_group_arithmetic_lower_bound: 10 cycles per tile plus coefficient preparation, rank-state buffer service, barrier and drain/fill effects
composition_boundary.conditional_speedup_source: M161 Q8 rank-3 geometry and M165 independent capacity audit only; training and complete cycle admission remain required

INT8 folded-left and Q24 folded-bias checkpoint quantization or overflow proof
